title: Large Language Model for Table Processing: A Survey
note: Surveys LLM- and VLM-based table processing across question answering, image-table extraction, spreadsheet manipulation, training, prompting, and agents.

title: Tabular Data Understanding with LLMs: A Survey of Recent Advances and Challenges
note: Organizes tabular representations and understanding tasks while highlighting complex structures, multimodal inputs, long tables, and multi-table reasoning.

title: Table Question Answering in the Era of Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Tasks, Methods, and Evaluation
note: Reviews TableQA task formulations, benchmarks, reasoning challenges, LLM methods, evaluation practices, and emerging reinforcement-learning directions.

title: A Survey of Table Reasoning with Large Language Models
note: Surveys LLM-era table reasoning techniques, analyzes why LLMs improve tabular reasoning, and outlines methodological and application-oriented research directions.

title: Table Pre-training: A Survey on Model Architectures, Pre-training Objectives, and Downstream Tasks
note: Reviews table pre-training architectures, objectives, and downstream tasks including question answering, table search, relation classification, and formula prediction.
